task.title: Reconcile planning-build test strategy lint coverage
task.summary: Adjust the planning-build lint/reconciliation rule so accepted planning builds with durable row/question evidence and roadmap/test handoff evidence no longer surface as uncovered missing-test-strategy drift after their tasks close.

goal.outcome: The current `planning-build-missing-test-strategy` reconciliation warning is resolved by source-owned lint behavior and regression tests rather than by leaving stale historic planning-build warnings uncovered.
acceptance: Planning-build lint still warns when a planning build has no TDD plan, candidate test files, evidence mapping, acceptance mapping, or durable row/question evidence.
Planning-build lint does not warn when a planning build maps rows/questions to roadmap tasks or deferred/knowledge dispositions with evidence.
The existing Pi distribution correction planning builds no longer create uncovered `planning-build-missing-test-strategy` reconciliation items after graph refresh.
Regression test covers both missing and durable-evidence planning build cases.
non_goals: Do not rewrite historic planning builds.
Do not hide planning-build errors or missing source decision/build refs.
Do not weaken implementation-build validation or task-close proof requirements.
verification: targeted TASK-074 planning lint smoke test

delta.desired: Lint/reconciliation treats durable planning row/question evidence as valid planning strategy evidence while preserving warnings for truly strategy-free planning builds.
delta.current: Graph reconciliation reports `planning-build-missing-test-strategy` for accepted planning builds that have row/question evidence but empty explicit TDD fields, with no open roadmap coverage.
delta.closure: Task closes after source lint behavior and regression tests pass and graph no longer routes the stale warning as uncovered work.
